mapper.select: select DATE_FORMAT(record_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, avg(mood_score) as avgScore, mood_label as moodLabel from mood_record where user_id = #{userId} and record_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) group by DATE_FORMAT(record_time, '%Y-%m-%d'), mood_label order by date asc

select mood_label as label, count(*) as count, round(count(*) * 100.0 / (select count(*) from mood_record where user_id = #{userId}), 1) as percentage from mood_record where user_id = #{userId} group by mood_label order by count(*) desc
select avg(sleep_hours) as avgSleep, avg(exercise_minutes) as avgExercise, avg(energy_level) as avgEnergy, avg(mood_score) as avgMood from mood_record where user_id = #{userId}

select count(*) as totalRecords, avg(mood_score) as avgScore, max(mood_score) as maxScore, min(mood_score) as minScore, (select mood_label from mood_record where user_id = #{userId} and mood_score = (select max(mood_score) from mood_record where user_id = #{userId}) limit 1) as bestMood, (select mood_label from mood_record where user_id = #{userId} and mood_score = (select min(mood_score) from mood_record where user_id = #{userId}) limit 1) as worstMood, COALESCE(( select datediff( max(record_time), (select record_time from mood_record where user_id = #{userId} and record_time < (select max(record_time) from mood_record where user_id = #{userId}) order by record_time desc limit 1) ) from mood_record where user_id = #{userId} and record_time = (select max(record_time) from mood_record where user_id = #{userId}) ), 0) as streakDays from mood_record where user_id = #{userId}
